summary: HTTP client library with ping/POST/GET primitives; no traced installer harm
details: Package ships an Instagram API wrapper client (lib/lib/client.service.js) that uses standard HTTP primitives (GET/POST) and contains a 'ping' keyword co-occurring with these calls in the same bundle. Static keyword co-occurrence matched on these primitives, but the package's documented purpose is an HTTP API wrapper, so these primitives are the expected shape of its advertised functionality. No install-time or import-time execution of fetched code, no reads of installer secret paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles), no environment-variable scraping, no hardcoded non-first-party exfiltration destination, and no lifecycle scripts that fetch and execute remote content were observed in the shipped files.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
